reviews.x: I loved everything about this diffuser except that I don’t like lights when I’m sleeping. I turned off the light setting but apparently when the water runs out it flashes red five times very brightly!!  It’s like having a police light in your bedroom!  I spray-painted the cover black and I don’t notice the red shut off lights anymore.
Used this a hand full of times in my bedroom for sleep. My daughter walked by the room just as my smoke alarm went off.  I have four of these. Getting rid of them all.

I thought the newer 3rd gen version would be more awesome so when the 300 ml version in my room bit the dust I bought it. Disappointed and will be returning. Supposed to be more quiet but is actually louder than it’s predecessor. And the noise is a different sound, annoying not calming. The mist is also not nearly as strong or fragrant as the older version.

I like the looks and features of this diffuser, but it's very hard to turn on. I've made sure the cover is on correctly, that there isn't too much/not enough water, etc. and it still doesn't turn on well. I have used it twice since receiving it, and I've basically just had to keep unplugging it and then plugging it back in, and pushing  the button a bunch of times before it randomly turns on. Once it starts running, I have no complaints about it.

reviews.t: Works great, soft noise, long lasting.
reviews.x: Used this for post surgery recovery to fill the room with lavender. It works really well, lasts a long time. It makes some noise but I found it to be soothing. I never use the lights though there are several colors. Too bright for at night.

I love that it turns off by itself. I can go to sleep without worrying. Being able to use the oils I like and the being able to change the light color or turn the light off is a plus. I bought one for my daughter also.
Not worth the money stop working after 2 months of use.

claims.text: Many reviewers are highly satisfied, praising the diffuser as effective, easy to use, and good value.
Several reviewers praise the colorful, changing lights.
Some reviewers find the unit too small and short-running, with limited water capacity.
A few reviewers report serious reliability and safety problems, including a fire and units that stopped working.
Some reviewers complain about the light behavior, including bright flashing when water runs out and a sleep button that seems to do nothing.
